stories.title: Russische Öllieferungen an USA – Trump erlaubt russische Dieselimporte

en.title: Russian Oil Supplies to USA – Trump Permits Russian Diesel Imports
en.summary: Trump has arranged to allow diesel imports from Russia to address high fuel prices in the United States, according to reports of a deal reached with Putin.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Entfesselte Partykultur auf dem Campus: Sexuelle Freiheit verlangt auch Risikobewusstsein

en.title: COMMENTARY - Unbridled Party Culture on Campus: Sexual Freedom Also Demands Risk Awareness
en.summary: An alleged abuse case at Cornell University has raised concerns about campus party culture involving sex, alcohol, and drugs, prompting discussion beyond immediate online judgments.

stories.title: GASTKOMMENTAR - Wenn Menschen es nicht wert sind, ersetzt zu werden – es gibt Fragen, auf die keine politische Partei eine Antwort weiss

en.title: GUEST COMMENTARY - When People Are Not Worth Replacing – There Are Questions to Which No Political Party Has an Answer
en.summary: Western concerns about immigration from the Global South and anxiety about artificial intelligence challenge political responses, as populist parties exploit some fears while traditional solutions fail against AI risks.

stories.title: En Suisse, la souveraineté énergétique du pays repose aussi sur l’éolien

en.title: In Switzerland, the Country's Energy Sovereignty Also Rests on Wind Power
en.summary: Switzerland identified strategic wind farm sites in 2004, but many projects remain blocked by lengthy procedures despite concerns about electricity shortages highlighted by regional instability.

stories.title: «Les machines sont là, qu’on le veuille ou pas»: sur les hauteurs de Vallorbe, l’éolien vaudois avance malgré les vents contraires à travers le pays

en.title: "Machines are here, whether we like it or not": in the heights of Vallorbe, Vaud wind power advances despite headwinds across the country
en.summary: Six wind turbines erected above Vallorbe will not generate electricity until 2028, after 20 years of debate and legal challenges. Wind energy currently represents only 0.2% of Switzerland's electricity consumption, significantly less than neighboring countries.

stories.title: Ciblés par des drones en Russie et au Moyen-Orient, des centres de données subissent des pertes définitives d’informations

en.title: Data centers targeted by drones in Russia and the Middle East suffer permanent information losses
en.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Yandex infrastructure in Russia while Amazon acknowledged irreversible data losses at a Bahreïn facility. Data centers, previously considered protected by global data replication, have become strategic targets in ongoing conflicts.

stories.title: Esther Friedli ne se présente pas à la succession de Guy Parmelin

en.title: Esther Friedli does not run to succeed Guy Parmelin
en.summary: UDC States Councillor Esther Friedli from Saint-Gall will not seek Guy Parmelin's Federal Council seat, preferring to focus on her cantonal mandate.

en.title: Federal Council Election – Parmelin Succession: Esther Friedli Declines
en.summary: Following Guy Parmelin's announcement of his departure, multiple candidates are positioning themselves to succeed him in the Federal Council.

stories.title: Un séisme de magnitude 7,7 provoque la panique dans la capitale du Panama

en.title: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake causes panic in Panama's capital
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama City on Friday, causing buildings and roads to collapse. Authorities reported at least two injured with no deaths in preliminary assessments.

stories.title: Un séisme de magnitude 7,7 secoue le Panama

en.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7.7 shakes Panama
en.summary: A 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck Panama on Friday, causing panic in the capital with no reported casualties. A tsunami alert was subsequently issued for the eastern Pacific region.

stories.title: Genève est en fête, le Nobel à Navi Pillay

en.title: Geneva celebrates as Nobel Prize goes to Navi Pillay
en.summary: The Nobel Committee honored the 85-year-old South African jurist for her integrity and courage in fighting impunity. Israel criticized the award as grotesque while the United States increased sanctions.

stories.title: Les Etats-Unis sanctionnent la CPI quelques heures après le prix Nobel de Navi Pillay

en.title: United States sanctions the ICC hours after Navi Pillay receives Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The U.S. government announced sanctions against the International Criminal Court on Friday, shortly after former South African judge Navi Pillay was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize, partly for her work at the institution.
